statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH (yellow). Ninety minutes into the Globex reopen, the 28,981.00 low set at 22:00 UTC has held and NQ has recovered to 29,063.50 (-1.10%) inside an unchanged 119-point band, so the gap is being absorbed rather than extended and Tail eases from 22 to 20. Stress stays high at 77 because crude is still up 2.29% after the Hormuz talks were postponed, the 10-year sits near 4.95%, and the FOMC decides on Wednesday.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold, so the mapped state is WATCH for both NQ futures and the NAS100 CFD. The danger window has been narrowed to 00:00-02:00 UTC, covering the Tokyo cash open as the first deep liquidity pool to price the AI-pacing story. Two later checkpoints follow: the 07:00 UTC European cash open and the 13:30 UTC US cash open, where the forecast re-enters the watch band before decaying again.
headline: Nasdaq-100 futures hold the 28,981 reopen low and recover to -1.10% as the AI-pacing gap is absorbed, with crude easing off its high ahead of Wednesday's FOMC
body:
A second hour of live price-path evidence materially improves the picture. NQ is quoted at 29,063.50, down 323.50 or 1.10%, against a 29,684.25 prior close, after opening the reopen at 28,997.75 and trading a 28,981.00-29,100.00 band as of 19:16 EDT. Investing.com independently shows the contract at -1.12%. The structure inside that band is the material point: the 28,981.00 low printed at the reopen has now held for more than an hour, the 119-point range has not expanded in either direction, and price sits in the upper half of it after recovering roughly 31 points in the last 45 minutes. That is genuine two-way discovery with a retracement that has extended rather than failed, which is the opposite of the repeated-extension-after-failed-pullback structure that would push Tail toward the blocking band.

The move also remains sector-specific rather than systemic. ES is down 0.52% against NQ's 1.10%, so the Nasdaq is underperforming by roughly two to one, consistent with a technology and semiconductor repricing of the weekend AI-pacing story rather than broad de-risking. Cross-assets stay unaligned, which argues for Stress over Tail: the 10-year note future is bid at 106.171875, up 0.06%, so yields are not confirming an inflation shock, and gold is down 0.65% at 4,380.40, which a genuine flight to safety would not produce. The energy leg has started to decay as well. WTI is up 2.29% at 102.34 after trading 101.59-103.44, having been near 103.13 an hour ago, so the impulse from Oman postponing the Salalah meeting between Iran and Gulf states on Hormuz management is fading at the margin rather than building.

The catalyst set behind the gap is verified and unchanged: Anthropic's CEO published an essay on Saturday calling for a slower pace of frontier AI development, and OpenAI's CEO said in an interview published the same weekend that an IPO in 2026 would be ill-advised. Those landed on a market that closed Friday complacent, with the VIX at 15.84 after an 11.21% decline and seven of eight megacaps higher on the session, which is why the repricing was sharp. The unresolved macro backdrop is what keeps Stress in the high band: the H.15 release shows the 2-year at 4.56% and the 10-year at 4.95%, fed funds futures price roughly an 85% chance of a hike, and the FOMC decision, projections and press conference all fall on Wednesday, outside this forecast window.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding published hours were available. Tail rose steadily through the weekend from 6 overnight to 17 by 15:00 UTC, then stepped through 16, 17, 18, 18, 19, 21 and 22 as the Globex reopen approached and arrived, crossing into the watch band at 21:00 UTC. The mapped state was EA_ON and green for the first 22 hours and WATCH and yellow for the final two. Stress climbed without interruption from 57 to 78 as the pre-FOMC rates and energy backdrop accumulated, while Confidence held near 86 before stepping down to the low-to-mid 70s from 16:00 UTC as the weekend evidence gap widened, then recovering to 78 once the reopen restored a live price path. The dominant mode was normal for 23 of the 24 hours and event/whipsaw in the final hour.
outlookSummary: The overnight window now splits differently than it did an hour ago, because the reopen itself has been partly absorbed. The concentrated conditional risk has moved forward to the 00:00-02:00 UTC stretch around the Tokyo cash open, the first deep liquidity pool to price the AI-pacing story; the specific invalidation is a decisive break of the 28,981.00 reopen low accompanied by shallow or failed pullbacks, and the forecast peaks at 22 there rather than in the block band because a real retracement has already occurred and extended. From the Asian mid-session onward the base case is continued absorption, with Tail decaying to a window low of 15 through the European midday. Two later checkpoints follow: the 07:00 UTC European cash open, the first deep cash market to price the story, and the 13:30 UTC US cash open, where the forecast re-enters the watch band and peaks again at 22 for the first full cash hour before decaying into the close. Monday's US calendar holds only routine 3-month and 6-month bill auctions at 15:30 UTC, so residual daytime risk is headline-driven, with crude the main transmission channel while the Salalah Iran-GCC meeting stays postponed rather than held. Stress remains in the high band across the entire window because nothing underlying resolves before Wednesday: a hike priced near 85%, the 10-year at 4.95%, crude above $100, and an AI-pacing debate that has had only one thin session to price.
